title: Only first uncaught exception is handed to ExceptionHandler

labels.name: area: core
labels.description: Issues related to the framework runtime

body:
- **I'm submitting a ...**
- [X] bug report
- [ ] feature request
- [ ] support request => Please do not submit support request here, see note at the top of this template.

**Current behavior**
An exception is thrown and gets printed in the browser's console. If there are other exceptions thrown afterwards, they don't come up in the browser's console and never reach `ExceptionHandler`.

**Expected/desired behavior**
Every exception thrown should reach `ExceptionHandler` (and therefore a maybe existing custom exception handler can kick in).
- **If the current behavior is a bug, please provide the steps to reproduce and if possible a minimal demo of the problem** 
  http://plnkr.co/edit/4pA92Dbkg5YXLbJ7dmhl?p=preview
  Click on any of the two buttons and you will see an exception in the browser's console. Do another button click and you will see that the click handler is called, but the exception isn't printed in the console.
  It doesn't matter if the consecutive exceptions are thrown from the same component, a child component or an asynchronous thing (like `window.setTimeout`).
- **What is the expected behavior?**
  Every button click should trigger an exception which comes up in the browser's console.
- **What is the motivation / use case for changing the behavior?**
  I found this bug while digging into implementing my own exception handler and reporting exceptions to a service like [https://exceptionless.com/](Exceptionless).
- **Please tell us about your environment:**
  My app was created with angular-cli beta 5.
- **Angular version:** 2.0.0-rc1
- **Browser:** all
- **Language:** TypeScript 1.8
